title: Input symbol at an interior position
statement: Let $x$ be a binary string, let $q$ be a control state of the dual transducer, let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$, and let $o$ be an output word. In the configuration on input $x$ with state $q$, input head at position $i+1$, and output $o$, the symbol read is the $i$th bit of $x$ when $i<|x|$, and no symbol when $i=|x|$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input and $i \le |x|$. In every configuration of the dual transducer on
$x$ with input head at position $i + 1$, the symbol read is the $i$-th bit of $x$ when
$i < |x|$ and the right boundary blank when $i = |x|$.
